01 / About

A little background.

My research revolves around reinforcement learning and large language models. I came up with on-policy distillation for LLMs, helped popularize offline RL, and was a core contributor to the Gemma and Gemini models. My work on reliable evaluation received an Outstanding Paper Award at NeurIPS.

Before Periodic Labs, I worked on reinforcement learning and reasoning at Meta and was a staff research scientist at Google DeepMind.

I completed my PhD at Mila with Aaron Courville and Marc Bellemare, spent a year with Geoffrey Hinton’s team at Google Brain in Toronto, and studied Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Bombay.
